name: Verify AI Assistant opens and greets user when icon is clicked
objective: Validate that clicking the Agentforce icon opens the AI Assistant panel and the assistant greets the user with a welcome message explaining its capabilities.
precondition: User is logged in and on the home page. Agentforce icon is visible.

steps.description: Verify the Agentforce icon is displayed on the home page
steps.expectedResult: Agentforce icon is visible on the home page

steps.description: Verify the assistant displays a greeting message
steps.expectedResult: The assistant greets the user with a welcome message

steps.description: Verify the assistant explains its capabilities
steps.expectedResult: The assistant provides information about what it can help with (raise tickets, check status, knowledge articles, etc.)
